authority.statement: This profile produces one trace_coverage evidence facet and nothing else. No value it computes may enter a reward, a comparison verdict, an estimate, an approval, or any execution decision.

pinned_upstream.harness_declared_relay_range: nemo-relay<1.0,>=0.5 under the hermes-agent nemo-relay extra
pinned_upstream.observability_config_version_rationale: The only version nemo-relay 0.8.2, nemo-relay 0.7.3 and the Fabric 0.2.0 validator all accept.

integration.configuration_channel: Fabric writes a Relay plugin TOML and points HERMES_NEMO_RELAY_PLUGINS_TOML at it
integration.ambient_configuration: rejected by the adapter before the runtime starts
integration.atof_sink_mode: append, forced by the adapter because Fabric finalizes the Relay session after every invocation

derives.cardinality: exactly one start and one matching end per invocation_id
derives.atof_match: the scope event whose category is agent and whose uuid is the ATIF session identity

expectation_sources.supplies: the ordered model requests and tool calls the rollout performed for one task

derives.cardinality: one start and one matching end per model request in the trace
derives.atof_match: scope events whose category is llm, ordered by emission within the root scope

derives.cardinality: one start and one matching end per tool call in the trace
derives.atof_match: scope events whose category is tool, ordered by emission within the root scope

expectation_sources.supplies: the harness lifecycle log the Fabric normalized result carries

derives.atof_match: mark events under the root scope
derives.required_rationale: Hermes emits harness marks at its own discretion. They are recorded when present and never counted against coverage when absent, because the profile cannot enumerate them in advance.

calculation.denominator: the expected event identities this profile derives from the declared sources for the run being scored
calculation.denominator_rule: The denominator is fixed before the ATOF stream is read. It may not be narrowed by anything observed in the stream, and an empty denominator is never complete.
steps: Partition the ATOF stream by root agent scope uuid. The append-mode file may hold several invocations, so a file is never assumed to be one run.
Derive expected event identities from the declared sources for this invocation.
Correlate each ATOF event to at most one expected identity using the match rules above.
Record observed, missing, unexpected and unmatched identities.
calculation.unexpected_rule: An unexpected identity is recorded in unexpected_event_ids and is never a reason for incomplete; it does not change the calculated status.
calculation.pairing_rule: A scope start and its end share one uuid. An unpaired start or end is a missing event, never a matched one.

status_rules.not_requested: The Campaign selected native-only evidence. No Relay configuration was written, no plugin was registered, and no ATOF artifact exists. This is not a failure and no reason codes are emitted.
unavailable: Relay was requested but the plugin never registered before the subject started.
Relay was requested but no ATOF artifact was produced.
Relay was requested but the harness fell back to its own direct ATIF/ATOF path, so the configuration Techtree wrote was not in force.
Relay was requested but the ordered teardown never ran, including a hard process death.
incomplete: Any required expected identity is missing.
A scope start has no matching end, or an end has no matching start.
The root agent scope did not both open and close.
A delivery or teardown diagnostic was recorded.
The ATOF stream exceeded a size bound and was truncated.

all_of: Relay registered before the subject started.
The root agent scope opened and closed.
Every required expected identity from every declared source correlated to an observed ATOF event.
No delivery or teardown diagnostic was recorded.
The ordered teardown ran to completion, flush and shutdown included.
This profile's digest and relay-coverage-v1 are both pinned in the evidence statement.
complete_for_profile.never: complete_for_profile is calculated from the list above. It is never asserted by an operator, a configuration flag, or the presence of an ATOF file.

teardown_constraints: The ordered flush must run outside the subject's own event loop. The synchronous subscriber flush refuses inside a running loop; the exporter flush does not refuse and therefore gives no warning that queued delivery was never awaited.
Clearing the plugin configuration can raise a classified delivery failure. That raise is a diagnostic to record, not a run to discard.
A successful flush establishes nothing about durable or lossless delivery.

size_bounds.observed_size_measurement: observed_seven_event_stream_bytes is the whole ATOF file on disk; observed_largest_single_event_bytes is its largest single JSON line in bytes, excluding the trailing newline.
size_bounds.on_exceeding: Stop retaining further events, record the bound that was hit, and classify the run incomplete. A bound may never be raised to make a run look complete.
size_bounds.bounds_are_techtree_owned: Relay 0.8.2 enforces none of these; every bound above is a Techtree limit.

blind_spots.statement: Relay 0.8.2 exposes no dropped-event counter, queue depth or delivery receipt for ATOF, and a stream sink that cannot deliver reports nothing to the caller. Missing events are detectable only against this profile's declared expectations.

The adapter records that Hermes 0.16 and later fall back to a direct ATIF/ATOF path when TOML initialization fails. That fallback was not exercised, and Techtree has no observed signal that distinguishes it from a configured run.
No Hermes subject ran under Relay in this spike. Every expectation above is derived from the Relay runtime's own behaviour and from the adapter source, not from an observed Hermes trajectory.
The adapter forces the ATOF file sink to append because Fabric finalizes the Relay session after every invocation. Multi-invocation partitioning is specified above but was not exercised.
Both ATIF projections dropped a refused model call that ATOF recorded, and the derived projection reported it as completed. ATIF is never a source of terminal status, failure class or coverage.

privacy.public_surface: the coverage status, this profile's digest, the calculation version, and reason codes
privacy.streaming_service: none; the file sink is the only sink this profile uses
privacy.note: The native ATIF file embeds the complete raw ATOF stream, so it carries no less private material than the ATOF file itself.
